japan.basis: lyricist 稲垣千穎 Inagaki Chikai (1913); composer Scottish trad. (Auld Lang Syne). The later of the two deaths is 1913.
japan.test: Japan: both authors died 1967 or earlier, or the work is anonymous and published 1967 or earlier.

us.basis: first published 1881, 小学唱歌集初編.
us.test: US: published 1930 or earlier, or published later with every author dead in 1945 or earlier, because the URAA restored anything still protected in its source country on 1996-01-01.

items.line: ほたるの ひかり まどの ゆき

gloss.en: By firefly light and snow at the window we piled up days of study; the years slipped by, and this morning we open the cedar door and part.
